answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Every claim climbs the harbor of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the anchor re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Reaching the opal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
